title: Juicy Light Canadian French Lentils Stir-fry
description: A sweet and juicy Canadian-inspired dish featuring marinated french lentils, pescatarian-friendly and light in texture.
instructions: Rinse and soak the French Lentils in cold water for at least an hour.
Chop the onion, garlic cloves, and red peppers into small pieces. If using, chop the sun-dried tomatoes as well.
In a large pan or wok, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add onions and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and red pepper if using, stirring to combine with onions for another minute.
Stir in lentils, thyme leaves (if using), balsamic vinegar, salt, and black pepper. Cook for about 5-7 minutes or until the lentils start to absorb the flavors.
Toss in sun-dried tomatoes and lemon zest, cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and let everything simmer together for another 10-15 minutes or until the lentils are tender and all the ingredients are well combined.
